requirements.quote: one autonomous NFT raffle
requirements.checkable: Underspecified: the interface does not define an operational criterion for raffle autonomy.

requirements.quote: fixed-price USDC entries
requirements.checkable: Entry purchases use USDC at a fixed per-entry price.

requirements.quote: one transferable ERC-721 ticket per purchase.
requirements.checkable: Each successful purchase mints exactly one ERC-721 ticket.

requirements.quote: Ticket IDs are sequential.
requirements.checkable: Successive purchases receive consecutive ticket IDs.

requirements.quote: Each ticket stores one inclusive uint128 entry range
requirements.checkable: Each ticket has one stored entry interval with inclusive uint128 endpoints.

requirements.quote: remains a transferable bearer claim until its owner atomically burns it for redemption or refund.
requirements.checkable: Until redemption or refund burns a ticket, its claim follows its current owner through permitted transfers.

requirements.quote: its owner atomically burns it for redemption or refund.
requirements.checkable: Refunding a ticket atomically exchanges its owner's ticket burn for the refund payment.

requirements.quote: The immutable quote token
requirements.checkable: The configured quote-token address cannot change.

requirements.quote: canonical six-decimal USDC
requirements.checkable: The quote token is the deployment's canonical USDC; this interface supplies no address establishing canonical identity.

requirements.quote: six-decimal USDC
requirements.checkable: Quote-token amounts use six decimal places.

requirements.quote: standard, non-rebasing, fee-free transfers.
requirements.checkable: The quote token is assumed to provide standard ERC-20 transfer behavior.

requirements.quote: non-rebasing
requirements.checkable: The quote token is assumed not to rebase balances.

requirements.quote: fee-free transfers.
requirements.checkable: Quote-token transfers are assumed to move the specified amount without transfer fees.

requirements.quote: Supported prizes are honest,
requirements.checkable: Underspecified: prize-token honesty is assumed, but the interface does not define the behaviors constituting honesty.

requirements.quote: standards-compliant ERC-721s.
requirements.checkable: Supported prize contracts are assumed to comply with ERC-721.

requirements.quote: The single authoritative raffle lifecycle and economic result.
requirements.checkable: Status is the authoritative representation of the raffle's lifecycle and economic outcome.

requirements.quote: The clone is initialized
requirements.checkable: An AwaitingPrize clone has completed initialization.

requirements.quote: waiting for the factory to escrow the configured prize.
requirements.checkable: AwaitingPrize represents a clone awaiting factory escrow of its configured prize.

requirements.quote: The prize is escrowed
requirements.checkable: An Active raffle has its configured prize escrowed.

requirements.quote: entry sales or post-sale draw initiation are available.
requirements.checkable: Active permits entry sales subject to the documented sale conditions.

requirements.quote: post-sale draw initiation are available.
requirements.checkable: Active permits post-sale draw initiation subject to the documented request conditions.

requirements.quote: A Chainlink VRF request was accepted
requirements.checkable: Drawing represents an accepted Chainlink VRF request.

requirements.quote: its callback window is open.
requirements.checkable: Drawing denotes an open callback window for the accepted request.

requirements.quote: The reserve was met
requirements.checkable: NftWon is an outcome for which the reserve-entry threshold was met.

requirements.quote: the winning ticket may redeem the prize NFT.
requirements.checkable: In NftWon, the winning ticket carries the right to redeem the prize NFT.

requirements.quote: The reserve was missed
requirements.checkable: CashWon is an outcome for which the reserve-entry threshold was not met.

requirements.quote: the winning ticket may redeem its cash allocation.
requirements.checkable: In CashWon, the winning ticket carries the right to redeem its cash allocation.

requirements.quote: Full ticket refunds are enabled
requirements.checkable: Refunding enables full ticket refunds.

requirements.quote: the sponsor may recover the prize NFT.
requirements.checkable: Refunding permits recovery of the prize NFT for the sponsor.

requirements.quote: Prize depositor
requirements.checkable: The configured sponsor identifies the prize depositor.

requirements.quote: Immutable recipient of protocol fees.
